names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 martie, «Sfântul Cuvios Ștefan, făcătorul de minuni».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 26 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Στέφανος ο Ομολογητής, ηγούμενος Τριγλίας», with the rank word left off.

floruit.note: doxologia.ro: «a fost în anii împăratului Leon Armeanul (813-820)» — the reign the life gives, in which he was summoned, tortured and sent into exile, where he died. The life gives no year for his death.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 28 martie — «Sfântul Cuvios Ștefan, făcătorul de minuni»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Στέφανος ο Ομολογητής, ηγούμενος Τριγλίας»

attestations.note: The Greek calendar keeps him on 26 March, two days before the Romanian 28 martie already recorded on this folder; saint.gr's own page repeats 26 March as its «Ημερομηνία Εορτής» and marks the feast «Σταθερή», fixed. The page agrees with doxologia on the man — abbot of Triglia under Leo the Armenian, 813 to 820, imprisoned and exiled for the icons, dead in exile — and adds that he left the monastery and went down into the city to strengthen the persecuted. It prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Cu curgerile lacrimilor tale ai lucrat pustiul cel neroditor şi cu suspinurile cele dintru adânc ai făcut ostenelile tale însutit roditoare; şi te-ai făcut luminător lumii, strălucind cu minunile, Ştefan, părintele nostru. Roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Ştefan, făcătorul de minuni

english.text: With the streams of thy tears thou didst till the barren desert, and with sighs from the depths thou didst make thy labours bear fruit a hundredfold; and thou becamest a light to the world, shining with miracles, O Stephen our father. Pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.
